title: Net Lease Office Properties Announces Postponement of Annual Meeting of Shareholders
summary: Net Lease Office Properties Inc. ("NLOP" or the "Company") announced that its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders (the "Annual Meeting"), held on June 12, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time, was convened and adjourned without any business being conducted, in order to provide additional time for the Company to solicit proxies. NLOP's Board of Trustees unanimously recommends that shareholders vote "FOR" all proposals. The Annual Meeting will reconvene virtually on June 25, 2026 at 9:30 a.m. Eastern Time to provide shareholders additional time to vote on the proposals described in the proxy statement filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC") on April 16, 2026. No changes have been made in the proposals to be voted on by Shareholders at the Annual Meeting.
